description.value: Hop & Vine is a long-established taphouse in Burnaby's Greystone Village near Burnaby Mountain Golf Course, with over 20 years as a community fixture. It features 24 rotating draught lines and one of the largest craft beer selections in the area, alongside a food menu built around fresh, local, and sustainable ingredients well beyond typical pub fare. Cyclists exploring the Burnaby Mountain trails will find a warm, lively atmosphere and a full menu of scratch-made food and drink. Note that this is a 19+ venue with no minors permitted.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website at hoptaphouse.ca is live and provides the business address as '1601 Burnwood Drive #9, Burnaby, BC' — contradicting the OSM community tag of 'North Vancouver'; the phone number matches OSM. No mention of bike parking, bike racks, washrooms, takeout, or Wi-Fi appears anywhere in the website content, so those fields are null. The food menu explicitly flags one item as Gluten Free ('*Spuds are Gluten Free'), providing positive evidence for at least partial GF options.
concerns: Community mismatch: OSM community tag is 'North Vancouver' but website address is '1601 Burnwood Drive #9, Burnaby, BC'. OSM coordinates (~49.2696, -122.9465) are consistent with Burnaby, not North Vancouver.
Venue is 19+ only with no minors permitted — relevant limitation for family touring cyclists.
OSM record has no address field populated; address sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: The venue is a legitimate, long-running pub suitable for touring cyclists, but the OSM record places it in 'North Vancouver' while the website address is clearly Burnaby — the community assignment needs correction before publishing. Additionally, the 19+ only policy limits utility for family cycling groups.
